capabilities: guard Close current tab so pinned tabs are unaffected
limit Close all other tabs to non-pinned tabs
limit Close tab group to non-pinned tabs
disambiguation: Not a tab manager; it only blocks existing built-in close commands from affecting pinned tabs.
extras: Only guards commands triggered by hotkeys or the command palette; closing via the right-click context menu is not affected. No configuration needed.
problem: In Obsidian, Cmd/Ctrl+W, 'Close all other tabs' and 'Close tab group' unpin or close pinned tabs that users keep open on purpose.
summary: Tab guard that intercepts built-in close commands so pinned tabs are not unpinned or accidentally closed.
